book.name: ACTS
book.title: In o Oꞌohanas g Haꞌichu hab ha-Juni g Jesus Chuhchai

content: Matsh haꞌi e doꞌibia g gawul mahs hemajkam
Sh am dadha g siant shondal Cesaria kihhim t am mash ab amjed g Italy jewed. Kush g ha‑uhgchuga hab chehgig Cornelius
ch ash si oid g Jiosh himdag ch am ep i ha wehmt g shoꞌigkam Tutuligo ch ab ihm g Jiosh. Kush g wehmaj kihkam wehsijj hab waꞌap ab si ihm g Jiosh.
Sh hema tash mash d i waik ohla im hab i juhk, tsh am nenaj ed hab e juh matsh am jiwia g anghil k am si chehch hab kaijch, “Cornelius.”

Sh ab hu wabsh si neid ihda anghil ch wabsh s‑ehbeni ch hab kaij, “Shahchu ap ahgahim ch ab neok?” Sh hab kaij g anghil, “Ab o kaiham g Jiosh g m‑hoꞌigeꞌidahuna ch s‑hohhoꞌid hegai map haschu am hab junihim g shoꞌigkam ha wehhejed.
Pegih, pt hemuch haꞌi wo ha cheha g chechoj mat am wo hihi Joppa wui k am wo nei hegai mo hab chehgig Simon Peter.
Am o da heg kih am mo d hogi chikpandam ch hab waꞌap chehgig Simon ch am kih ge kahchki hugid an.”
Tsh amjed gam hu hahawa hih hegai anghil mash ab wui neok. Tsh g Cornelius am hahawa waik ha wai g e‑pionag. Sh hema idam d shondal ch si oid g Jiosh himdag.
Kutsh am ha ahgi idam matsh haschu has e juh k am hahawa ha cheha mat gam hu wo hihi Joppa wui.
Sh am baꞌich d i tash matsh am dahm i juh, sh am wabsh kia hihim idam ch ab hi wa aihim g kihhim. Tsh eda g Peter gm hu hejelko him k am e hoꞌigeꞌidahun.
k ash am i si bihugim k chum haꞌichu s‑hugimk. Tsh eda koi bai g hihidod. Kutsh am Peter nena ed hab e juh
matsh ab i e kuhpiꞌo g dahm kahchim. Kutsh ab haꞌichu i e huduni jewedo k hab mahs mo g lohna ch shaꞌi si geꞌej ch an aꞌai e uꞌukch chuhchpulij an ch ab i tadanich.
Sh id eda am haꞌichug g nahnko mahs haꞌichu doakam ch wahammad ch uꞌuwhig.
Sh hab kaij g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag, “Peter, i g wuhshani k am wabsh chum haschu wo ha mua idam k hekaj wo e gegos.”
Tsh wabshaba g Peter hab si chei, “Ih, pi ant am hu hab wo ni‑juh, ni‑kownalig. Pi ani hekid koꞌa hegai mo g m‑chehanig pi t‑hiwgid machs wo koꞌad.”
Sh hab hahawa kaij hegai mo ab neok, “Pi g hab shaꞌi elid mas pi apꞌe hegai mo haschu g Jiosh hemu am m‑chehgid mo s‑apꞌe.”
Tsh waikko hab e juh ihda am nenaj ed. Tsh amjed im hu hahawa uhpam i e bei ihda haꞌichu am dahm kahchim wui.
Sh am wabsh kia oidahim g Peter hegai matsh haschu nei. Tsh heg i eda idam Cornelius pionag am i s‑mai mo hebai i kih g Simon k am dada k ab gegok kolhai kihjeg t ab
ch ab si s‑kaidam ha kakke, “No ia hema daha mo hab chehgig Simon Peter?”
Kush eda g Peter am wabsh kia chum aꞌamichud mas has d ahga hegai mat am nei. Kush hab kaij g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag, “Neh, ia at haꞌi dada k s‑m‑neidam.
Pt am wo i e nakog k am wo ha nei. Pi g has shaꞌi ha elid mo d ge gawul mahs hemajkam k wabsh wo ha oi. Ahni o d ni‑tatchui mat ab i hihi.”
Tsh wa woho am i hud g Peter k hab kaij ab ha wui idam oꞌodham, “Ahni ani wud mam s‑ni‑neidamk. Shahchu amt ahgk ia dada?”

Sh hab hahawa kaij idam oꞌodham, “No pi ab t‑chehani g Cornelius. Heg o d shondal ha‑uhgchuga Cesaria t ab ch si s‑ap d oꞌodham k ch ab si ihm g Jiosh. K g Tutuligo hab waꞌap ab si has elid. Tsh g anghil ab wui i hih ab amjed g Jiosh k hab ahg mat ab wo i m‑wai e‑kih wui k wo m‑kah mapt haschu wo i ahgi.”
Tsh ab i ha wahpki g Peter idam waik oꞌodham mat am wo waꞌi kohk. Sh an baꞌich d i tash, tsh i e nakog k gam hu hahawa ha oi. Tsh haꞌi ep ha oi hegam mash d Jesus ihmdam ch ab d kihkam Joppa t ab.
Am baꞌich d ep i tash. Tsh ged hu hahawa dada Cesaria t am. Tsh oi wa g Cornelius heki hu am i ha wai g e‑hajuni ch e‑naipijju. Kush idam am wehmaj ha nenida.
Tsh ab wabsh chum i wah g Peter. Tsh g Cornelius ab si daꞌiwuni k ab si i gei wecho ab si has elidch.
Tsh wabshaba hab ah g Peter, “Pi g shaꞌi ni‑wui i gehsh. Dani wabsh oꞌodham.”
Kush am e wehm neneokhim ch am i wahp. Sh am muꞌi dadha g hemajkam.

Kush am ha neid g Peter ch hab kaij ab ha wui, “Am am wa s‑mahch mach ahchim Tutuligo pi shaꞌi hiwgidas ab t‑himdag amjed machs ab wo i s‑em‑hajunima ahpim mam d gawul mahs hemajkam, niꞌichs am hu wo em‑chehgim em‑kihki wui. T wabshaba g Jiosh am ni‑chehgi mant iꞌajed pi am hu has wo shaꞌi em‑elidad.
Nt hekaj ab i hih pi shaꞌi has elidk mam d ge gawul mahs hemajkam. Pegih, m haschu ahgch am ni‑waid.”
Sh hab kaij g Cornelius, “Am ani ni‑hoꞌigeꞌidahun ni‑kih am d hu hema i tako imhab i juhk. T am haha wabsh hema jiwia g oꞌodham. K si tonod g wehschugaj. K ab kehk ni‑wui
ch hab kaij, ‘Cornelius, ab o kaiham g Jiosh g m‑hoꞌigeꞌidahuna ch s‑hohhoꞌid hegai map haschu am hab junihim g shoꞌigkam ha wehhejed.

Pt wo haꞌi ha cheha mat am wo hihi Joppa wui k am wo wai hegai oꞌodham mo hab chehgig Simon Peter. Am wo da heg kih am mo d hogi chikpandam ch hab chehgig Simon ch an kih ge kahchki hugid an.’ Neh, bo kaij.
“Kunt am hahawa haꞌi ha cheha mat am hihim k ab i m‑wai. Kupt s‑ap e juh k ab i hih. Kuch hemuch ia dadha am nenaj ed g Jiosh ch s‑kaimk hegai mat haschu g Jiosh am wo i m‑ahgi mapt am hab wo chei.”
Matsh haschu k ab ha mihshmad g Peter
Tsh wa woho am hahawa haꞌichu i ahgahi g Peter k hab kaij, “Hahawa ant wa s‑mai moki woho mo g Jiosh wehs ha wepo masma ha neid g nahnko mahs hemajkam.
K hegam d si tatchuij mo hedai ab i si has elid ch am hab junihim g s‑apꞌekam, chum as pi d wo Tutuligo hemajkamk.

Am amki chum heki hu kah ab amjed ihda mant haschu wo i em‑ahgi nam pi ia t‑shahgid dadha ahchim Tutuligo. K ahchim am t‑ahgid g Jiosh mash s‑ha doꞌibiamk g hemajkam am gahi wuhshanim g e‑alidag Jesus Christ. Heg o wud mat g Jiosh am i kei mat wehs d wo ha‑kownaligk g nahnko mahs hemajkam.

K wa am hema t‑jehnigid ab amjed g Jesus ch am t‑pahl wapkon ch hab chehgig John. T am i wuhsh g Jesus k am e pahl wako heg ab John. T g Jiosh ab mah g si geꞌe gewkdag am gahi wuhshanim g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag mat hekaj hab wo junihid g e‑chikpan. T g Jesus am i shonwuich g e‑chikpan Galilee chekshani ch ed k am hahawa wehsko hab junihim Judea chekshani ch ed. Jiosh o am wehmaj. K hekaj wehsko i ha wehmt g e‑hemajkamga ch ha dodajid hegam mo g jiawul ha shoꞌigchud.
“Kuch ahchim am wehmajkahim ch g si t‑wuhpuikaj neid hegai mo haschu hab junihim am wehsko t‑jewedga ed ch am Jerusalem ch ed. Kumt an be k mua ab naggiak kots t ab.
T wabshaba g Jiosh ab uhpam i wuhshad muhkig amjed mo d i waik tash k am i t‑chehgi.
K pi wabsh chum hedai neid. Ahchim ach waꞌi neid mat heꞌekiajj g Jiosh heki hu am i t‑chuhcha. Tt wa am wehmaj t‑gegos am i dahm mat g Jiosh ab i wuhshad muhkig amjed.
Jiosh atsh am si i kei matsh wo ha doꞌibia hegam mat ab wo hiwgad k wo ha lodai hegam mat pi wo e doꞌibia. T g Jesus ab t‑mohtoꞌi matt am wo si wohokamch ihda k am wo ahgahid g s‑kehg haꞌichu ahgaj.
Jiosh at gam hu hab wo i juh g pi ap ha‑chuꞌijig wehs hegam mat ab wo i s‑wohoch g haꞌichu ahgaj ab amjed g Jesus. Id o wehsijj wohokamchud g kekelibad Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam.”
Matsh g gawul mahs hemajkam ab bei g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag
Sh am wabsh kia neok g Peter. Tsh ab i hud g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ha dahm hegam mo am kaiham k ab si i ha mah g gewkdag.

Tsh am gawul neꞌokikaj neneo mat pi hebai mai k ab si ihm g Jiosh. Tsh am i ha kaiok ab si e totods hegam mo wehmaj g Peter natki pi g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag ab si i ha mah g gewkdag hegam gawul mahs hemajkam.
Sh ab kaij g Peter, “Jiosh atki ab i ha mah g Hekia S‑apꞌekam Gewkdag mat hab masma ab i t‑mah. No hig pi d ha wuikam mat wo e pahl wapko?”
Kumtsh wa woho ha pahl wapko am chehchegch g Jesus Christ. Sh idam ab hahawa si ahgid g Peter mat am wo shaꞌi ha wehm dakahim heꞌekia i tash.
